name: Mink Daisakusen
source:
A god brought three heroes to the other world. Will you be able to gather the party, rescue friends and return to the original world?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-december-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一位神将三位英雄带到了另一个世界。你能召集队伍，营救朋友，回到原来的世界吗？

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-december-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
